outro_summary: Richie returns expecting his old reputation to restore his position. Tony insists that the current hierarchy still applies. The Beansie dispute exposes Richie's refusal to accept those limits; disrupting the poker game makes that refusal public. His apology lowers the temperature, but Tony turns the dispute into a cost: Tony gets paid first.
